parts.note_add: 8 bolts 0338-19-737 with plain washers 0338-19-739 (S-005 fig 1920A-1); the rear oil seal 0437-17-335A and the speedometer driven gear sleeve sit in it. Removal of the propeller shaft: fit turning holder 49 0259 440 in the housing so fluid does not run out (S-045 7A:1).
Discard and renew whenever the housing comes off; the Cobra 53002F 3N71B overhaul kit (S-201) supplies the gaskets and seals.

Nine attaching bolts in three lengths: 4x 0338-19-831, 2x 0338-19-832, 3x 0338-19-833 (S-005 fig 1920A-2); keep them sorted by length at removal (S-002 7B-32). Upper body, separator plate and lower body; the lower body carries the throttle relief ball and the orifice check valve with their springs (S-045 7A:12).
Slides off the valve body; on installation the pin on the manual plate must sit in its groove (S-045 7A:12, 7A:17).

Aftermarket filter kits cross to 1758-19-815: Raybestos 357418 (filter 515418 + nitrile gasket 22G418, L3N71B with external servo 1974-83) and ATP B-416 (1979-83 RX-7). Bolted to the underside of the control valve body.

BT07-19-823 is the current Mazda number and supersedes 0338-19-823 and 1758-19-823; still sold new by Atkins Rotary and Mazdatrix. Its vacuum sensing tube runs to the carburettor base (S-045 7A:1; rx7club). Takes the selective rod PT355; do not leave the rod stuck in the diaphragm tip at removal (S-002 7B-32).
Selected from the measured depth of the vacuum throttle valve bore after any change of control valve body or case (S-045 7A:17, S-002 7B-78).

Mazda has discontinued 1758-19-835; Atkins Rotary still stocks and can make it. A parts.mazdausa.com search listing shows 0338-19-835B as the current genuine number (check). Raybestos 22G418 (in kit 357418) and ATP B-416 are the aftermarket gaskets.

17 bolts 0338-19-837 (S-005 fig 1920A-2, page 1-D6); the ATP B-416 gasket is described as 14 bolt holes, check against the pan. Inspect what is in the pan at removal: dark or burnt fluid or friction particles point to the clutches or band, a tacky varnish film to sticking valves (S-002 7B-32).
Fluid is added through this tube; O-ring 9954-10-1601 at the case and two clips 3876-19-916 (S-005 fig 1920A-2).
Marked L and F; level is read hot, engine idling, selector in P after passing through every range (S-045 7A:18, S-002 0-24).
Holds the front clutch drum for 2nd gear (D2, 2 and 1-2nd); the servo piston stem sets its adjustment (S-002 7B-8). Removed with its strut after backing off the piston stem (S-045 7A:4).

Applied in 3rd and reverse (S-002 7B-8). Contains 3 drive and 3 driven plates (S-002 7B-2), a dished plate, the piston with two seals, 10 return springs, retainer and the selective retaining plate PT369.

3959- prefix is the '81-83 drum; the 1980 manual's front clutch took 7.2-8.2 mm retaining plates where this one takes 5.0-6.2 mm, so 1980 figures for the front clutch do not transfer (S-045 7A:7 vs S-005 fig 1930A-1).
Removed by compressed air into the clutch oil passage; fitted with even pressure round its rim so the seals are not cut (S-045 7A:7, S-002 7B-43).
Outer seal and inner seal per piston (S-045 fig 7A-23); never reused. The Cobra 53002F overhaul kit (S-201) supplies lip seals and O-rings.
10 springs and one retainer per clutch; compressed with tool 49 0378 375 to release the snap ring (S-002 7B-42, 7B-53).
One per clutch, first plate against the piston; direction is shown in the manual figure and matters (S-002 7B-43, 7B-54).
3 in the front clutch, 4 in the rear (S-002 7B-2). The Raybestos steel module STMMAZDA01 (S-202) lists 6 direct/forward steels, one short of the catalogue's 7: check before ordering.
3 in the front clutch, 4 in the rear (S-002 7B-2). Raybestos R560161 (1981-on forward/direct friction, S-202) is the aftermarket plate.
Sets the front clutch clearance; the 1985 manual lists the same 5.0-6.2 mm range for its front clutch (S-002 7B-53).
Applied in every forward range (D1, D2, D3, 2, 1); 4 drive and 4 driven plates (S-002 7B-2, 7B-8). Its retaining plate is not selective: an off-standard clearance means new plates (S-045 7A:8).
Comes out with the front clutch, rear clutch hub, front carrier, connecting shell and sun gear as one assembly (S-045 7A:4).
One thickness only (single catalogue number); clearance is corrected with plates, not this part (S-005 fig 1930A-1, S-045 7A:8).
Two hub numbers 0338-19-530 and -531 retained by snap ring 0338-19-534 (S-005 fig 1930A-1); fitted with the front planetary carrier on top of the rear clutch (S-002 7B-70).
Replaced as a unit if the pinion washer clearance is over the limit (S-045 7A:14).

Shell alone is 0338-19-565 (S-005 fig 1930A-1). Total end play is read by moving the connecting shell fore and aft with a screwdriver behind it, dial indicator on the input shaft; front clutch drum end play is the feeler gap between the front clutch drum and this shell (S-045 7A:16).
Directional: the grooved face goes to the front, where the carrier washer bears on it (S-002 7B-55).
